notes: A lyrics sheet that arrived with its own timestamps printed the tags as part of the words and then scrolled on an even split of the whole song - the "all over the place" report. The tags are never shown now and the sheet follows its own times.

Every way a timing is written is read now: [mm:ss], [mm:ss.xx], [mm:ss:xx], angle brackets and full-width brackets. A saved sheet whose timing flag was lost is repaired on the spot, so it stays timed after a restart.

Every save of your playlists and your albums now passes one guard: a write that would drop an entry still in the store has it put back before the row is stored, so a boot rebuild, a failed read, a heal pass or a restore cannot delete one.
Only the two things you do yourself - deleting a playlist or an album, and renaming either one - are allowed to remove an entry, and each announces itself first.
The guard covers albums as well as playlists, so nothing else in the app can quietly make an album or a list disappear.
Your songs, playlists and saved lyrics stay on your device — nothing in your library is removed by this release.
